description: Practice mode (only if the operator turned it on). Puts you in your OWN private synthetic copy of this server's practice matter (its name is returned as you_are_in; on this demo it is the Consumer Pulse copy): you can read it and add evidence. Nothing else.  Requires your actor_token. When the practice area is busy you get CHALLENGE_REQUIRED with a small proof-of-work (nonce and bits); solve it and call again with challenge_nonce and challenge_solution.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.
